preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to call withdraw function
Contract must have accumulated ETH balance from swap and liquidity operations

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the withdraw() function to transfer all ETH balance from the contract to the owner's address. The contract accumulates ETH through swapTokensForEth operations during token swaps and liquidity additions, which can be drained by the owner at any time.
